conservative.requirements: 6 favour, WP 4+, Weapon Skill trained, and engaged with target weapon. Special: This blessing counts as Bless Weapon in all respects and replaces that card in your action deck. Effect: Myrmidia blesses your weapon. While this blessing is recharging, the weapon is considered an enchanted and blessed item of superior quality and adds {Dc} to the dice pool. It gains the Pierce 2 and Vicious qualities. Attacks with the affected weapon
conservative.name: Improved Bless Weapon
